about: Launch values picked by sim/hat_tip_sim.py by the pre-registered decision rule; reasons and evidence in docs/SIMULATION.md. Field names and units are the contract's Config (I-1).
units: tUSD amounts in base units (6 decimals) as decimal strings; *_bp in basis points (10,000 = 100 %); auto_rep_min in whole thanks; auto_per_thanks and cosign_per_thanks in base units per whole thanks of reputation; round_ms in milliseconds. dao, token and genesis_ms are null here: they are set at deployment.

house.about: The labelled house members of the testnet demo and their published strategies (DESIGN.md, 'House members'). Accounts are <name>.<root>. Packages d and e read this block; the simulation plays exactly these rules.

members.name: ana
members.strategy: Works in about nine rounds out of ten. When working: fixes round(items_mean * lognormal(0, items_sigma)) items, posts a note naming them, and hands out 100 thanks: first welcome_each thanks to each of up to welcome_max guests who posted a note and gave thanks this round (picked at random), then the rest to the other house members in proportion to the items in their notes times lognormal(0, noise_sigma) noise, whole thanks, at most cap_per_receiver each and max_receivers in all, dropping anyone below focus of the top pick. Skips the round (no note, no thanks) otherwise.

council.name: council-a
council.strategy: Votes in the DAO by the published rule, at least two minutes after the payout is filed. Tier 2: approve, unless more than half of the receiver's points this round came from one giver whom the receiver also thanked with at least council_rule.partner_min thanks this round (a partner; a welcome of welcome_each thanks to a guest is not one); then reject. Tier 3: approve if at least three givers stand behind the receiver's points this round; otherwise reject.

council_rule.about: The fewest thanks the receiver must have given its top giver in the round for the council to read the pair as partners; picked by sim/hat_tip_sim.py council (docs/SIMULATION.md, 'The house council's partner threshold').

bounties.about: Sputnik DAO bounties in the testnet demo (DESIGN.md, 'Bounties'), played by scripts/house.mjs. Not simulated: the simulation plays the rounds without them; a finished bounty adds thanks_each of its poster's 100 thanks to the finisher.
bounties.member: The honest house members post, claim and finish bounties. While fewer than open_target bounties are open and none was posted in the last post_every_minutes, one of them (picked at random) posts a task from the list below as an AddBounty proposal: paid in tUSD from the DAO, one finisher, a claim deadline of deadline_minutes. A member that holds no claim claims an open bounty it did not post claim_after_minutes after the house first sees it open (bond: the DAO's bounty_bond), files the work with bounty_done work_minutes later, with the task's report as the proposal's text. When the council approves the work, the finisher's note that round names the bounty ('+ bounty #12'; a number after # is not an item count) and the poster gives the finisher thanks_each thanks on top of its regular thanks that round, also in a round it does not otherwise work (at most cap_per_receiver to one receiver).
bounties.council: Votes on bounty proposals at least two minutes after they are filed. AddBounty, two votes (council majority): approve a task a member or council member posts, paid in tUSD, between min_tusd and max_tusd, for one finisher, with a claim deadline of at most max_deadline_minutes, while fewer than max_open bounties are open; otherwise reject. BountyDone, one vote: approve the work a member files itself for a bounty it claimed and did not post, with a report of at least report_min_chars characters; otherwise reject.
